manager.label: Management team
manager.note: The master lists comma-joined teams. attribute 'team' keeps each team as one group (rendered 'the team of A, B and C'); 'person' attributes every fund to each member.

sentence.default: Across the {groups} categories with {min_group} or more rated funds, {top.label} leads its category ({top.group}) on long-term rank.
{count} of {total} current Q1 funds {count?has|have} been Q1 in every one of the {versions} genuine monthly uploads. Consistency is the signal a single month cannot show.
sentence.zero: None of the {total} current Q1 funds has held Q1 across all {versions} genuine monthly uploads.

insights.title: Best return per unit of risk

sentence.default: {count|fund is|funds are} in the top quarter of their category on {measure.label} while sitting in the top half on standard deviation: the return did not come from volatility alone.
sentence.zero: No fund combines a top-quarter {measure.label} with a top-half standard-deviation rank this month.

sentence.default: {count|fund sits|funds sit} in the top quartile on both phases. They captured the upside and held the downside.
sentence.one: 1 fund sits in the top quartile on both phases: it captured the upside and held the downside.
sentence.zero: No fund is top quartile on both the bull and the bear phases this month.

insights.title: Held up best when markets fell

sentence.default: {top.label} leads the bear-phase composite at {top.value}; useful for conservative allocations even where the bull rank is mid-table.
{count|fund ranks|funds rank} top-quartile on {measure.label} but bottom-quartile on standard deviation. The return came with the ride.
sentence.zero: No fund pairs a top-quartile {measure.label} with a bottom-quartile standard deviation this month.

sentence.default: {group.label} has the most top-quartile funds ({group.count} of {group.total} rated); {hit.label} has the highest hit rate, with {hit.count} of its {hit.total} rated funds in Q1. Houses with fewer than {min_group} rated funds are not ranked.

The master lists teams, not individuals: {group.label} manages {group.count|top-quartile fund|top-quartile funds} out of {group.total} rated. Teams with fewer than {min_group} rated funds are not ranked.

Among the {groups} categories with {min_group} or more rated funds, the gap between the best and worst fund on {measure.label} is widest in {group.label} ({group.value}); that is where picking well pays most.
{count|fund is|funds are} top quartile on composite rank and top quartile on expense: performance that is not being paid for twice.
sentence.zero: No fund is top quartile on both composite rank and expense this month.
